content.rendered:
Chargeback prevention
done right.

How do I benefit
from chargeback alerts?

Receive dispute notifications

Get notified as soon as a customer disputed a charge and have the option to issue a refund.

Automated process

You are given complete control over what situations will warrant a refund, and which won’t.

Save money and time

Chargeback alerts give you more time to spend on what really matters- growing your business.

Apply for Free

How it works

A chargeback alert will inform you when a customer has begun the dispute process. You’ll automatically receive an email, giving you up to three days to respond. By issuing the customer a refund, or otherwise dealing with their issue, you will be able to halt the chargeback process, and dramatically lower your chargeback ratio.

What it costs

For each chargeback alert issued, a $40 fee applies. No setup or annual fees. Our system runs by itself, saving merchants money every single month.

The application process is
quick and secure.

Apply online

It only takes a few minutes to complete our simple online application.

Get an instant quote

Once the application was completed, you will receive an instant quote via DocuSign.

Let us help you grow your business.

Low Rates | Secure Processing | No Setup Fees
